name: SaaS and communications platforms
description: Techlio engineers SaaS products and communications platforms: self-serve portals, billing, analytics, MCP servers and integrations that let AI agents use the product.
h1: SaaS engineering for products that *other software depends on.*
answer: Techlio builds and extends SaaS platforms, including the parts that make a product usable by AI agents. For Signal House we built a self-serve messaging and voice platform end to end. For Convert, an experimentation platform behind 40,000+ sites, we built full-stack experimentation and a remote MCP server for AI-driven workflows.
problems: Onboarding, registration and billing that still need a person on your side
Customers asking how their AI agents can use your product
New modules that must not slow down a performance-sensitive core
A roadmap larger than the in-house team

faqs.question: What is an MCP server and does our SaaS need one?
faqs.answer: An MCP server exposes your product's actions to AI assistants in a standard way, so a customer's agent can use your product directly. It is worth building when customers already ask for AI access. We built a remote MCP server for Convert.

faqs.question: Can you take a product from idea to launch?
faqs.answer: Yes. Signal House was delivered across discovery, design, development, deployment and support. We can also join an existing team for one module.

faqs.question: How do you add features without hurting performance?
faqs.answer: Performance is set as a requirement before the design, then measured in the release pipeline. On Convert the new experimentation work added no load time to the tracking snippet.
